findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, while you do not have an equivalent right. Because ongoing distribution and fees are honored during the notice period, this is a low risk.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, without cause, upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other party.
